messages.subject: Error: HTTP 409 / 1 tasks in progress
parts:
Hello,

I have read through similar problems in older threads and it appears that when this error occurs for others, external help is required. Here is the order of events:

1. I attempted to re-deploy my app this morning and RStudio was stuck on the "Waiting for tasks 216083613" during the deployment process.
2. I closed and re-opened RStudio.
3. I now have the following error: 

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 111729...DONE
Deploying bundle: 513385 for application: 111729 ...
Error: HTTP 409
POST https://api.shinyapps.io/v1/applications/111729/deploy
Unable to dispatch task for application-111729: 1 tasks in progress
Execution halted

App Info:
Id 111729
Name Global_Stock_Assessment_Shiny

Thank you.

Cheers,

Kristin PJ
